 Edited By : Riya Ashok Madayi Last Updated: 16 Nov 2026, 09:55 am IST 3 min Share
 Follow us on Mammootty’s upcoming Tamil film ‘OM’, co-starring Dhanush, is expected to open to over Rs 15 crore net worldwide. The actor is also eyeing a career milestone after narrowly missing a double-digit India opening with ‘Patriot’. 
 ❎ Mammootty as Siya in the upcoming action drama ‘OM’. Photo | X
 Mammootty could achieve a significant box office milestone with his upcoming film ‘OM’, which also stars Dhanush. The action drama is expected to give the Malayalam superstar his first double-digit opening-day collection in India, a mark he narrowly missed with his previous release, ‘Patriot’.
 To advertise here, Contact Us 
 Directed by Rajkumar Periaswamy of ‘Amaran’ fame, ‘OM’ is scheduled to hit theatres on November 20. The film brings together Mammootty, Dhanush, Sai Pallavi and Sreeleela, with its trailer released on November 13. Mammootty's return to Tamil cinema after seven years is another major talking point, following his acclaimed performance in ‘Peranbu’.
 The actor has already drawn attention for his appearance as Siya, the character at the centre of the film's smuggling network. His collaboration with Dhanush has also raised expectations among audiences.
 ‘OM’ opening day box office prediction 
 According to current estimates, ‘OM’ is projected to collect more than Rs 15 crore net in India on its opening day. Its worldwide opening-day collection is expected to cross Rs 20 crore.
 ALSO READ:  Actor Mammootty returns to Tamil films after 7 years with 'OM' 
 The film is set to arrive in theatres on November 20, with no major competing release expected to significantly affect its opening in Tamil Nadu. Suriya's ‘ Scene ’, which arrived earlier in November, will have completed two weeks in theatres by then.
 These are early projections, and the film's actual opening will depend on advance bookings, screen availability and audience response.
 The ‘Patriot’ record Mammootty missed 
 Mammootty came close to scoring his first double-digit opening-day collection in India with ‘Patriot’. The Malayalam film reportedly earned Rs 9.8 crore net on its opening day, falling short of the Rs 10 crore mark by just Rs 20 lakh.
 With ‘OM’, the actor now has another opportunity to cross that milestone. If the opening-day estimates hold, the film could give him his first India net opening in double digits.
 What is ‘OM’ about? 
 ‘OM’ is a high-stakes action drama centred on a wood-smuggling network led by Mammootty's character, Siya. Sai Pallavi plays a senior police officer tasked with dismantling the operation, while Dhanush portrays an undercover officer sent to gain Siya's trust.
 The film also stars Sreeleela and features music by Sai Abhyankkar . Rajkumar Periaswamy, who previously directed ‘Amaran’, is at the helm.
 ALSO READ:  ‘A big whale is coming along with us’: Dulquer Salmaan on clash with Mammootty’s ‘Om’  
 Reports have placed the film's production budget at around Rs 200 crore, which, if accurate, would make it the most expensive project in the careers of both Mammootty and Dhanush. The makers have also indicated that parts of the story draw from real incidents.
 With Mammootty's return to Tamil cinema, a prominent ensemble cast and the scale of its action drama, ‘OM’ is among the notable theatrical releases scheduled for November 20.
